attribution: ELI codes, titles, definitions and major group assignments are published by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.

code_corrections.classification: DMI correction of an apparent BLS publication inconsistency. Not a BLS-authored change.
code_corrections.reason: Appendix 2 prints the 4-character item stratum code HA01. The pinned CE-CPI concordance and the CPI item structure both use the 5-character ELI HA011 for this item, and HA011 is the only HA-prefixed ELI reachable from the concordance. The row is retained under the corrected code so that the shelter ELI is not silently lost; the code as published is preserved in the source_code_as_published column.

normalization_note: Rows are retained where column 'Code' is a well-formed 5-character ELI (two letters then three digits), after applying the documented code_corrections. Definition whitespace is collapsed to single spaces. No other transformation is applied and no content row is dropped.
publication: Handbook of Methods, Consumer Price Index, Appendix 2: Content of CPI Entry Level Items
rows_excluded_detail: The workbook title row, the header row, and the trailing 'Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.' row. No content row is excluded.
usage_note: Supplies the BLS-authored ELI title and BLS major expenditure grouping required by Milestone 2 section 15. BLS publishes 8 major groups; the DMI taxonomy has 14 computation nodes, so BLS major group to DMI node is many-to-one and is not itself a BLS product.
